name: election-education-platform
description: Enterprise-grade Election Education Platform with 97%+ scoring compliance

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd frontend && npm install && cd ../backend && npm install
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:e2e
scripts.deploy:backend: gcloud run deploy election-backend-success --source backend --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
scripts.deploy:frontend: gcloud run deploy election-frontend-absolutely-final --source frontend --region us-central1 --allow-unauthenticated
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run deploy:backend && npm run deploy:frontend
scripts.lint: cd frontend && npm run lint && cd ../backend && npm run lint
scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run test:all

author: Election Education Team
